name: Compromised EC2 Host Isolation & Forensics Capture
description: Automated network containment and forensic snapshotting for EC2 instances exhibiting command-and-control communication, trojan activity, or cryptocurrency mining.

actions.name: CaptureHostMetadata
actions.description: Harvests instance metadata, VPC ID, subnet ID, public/private IP addresses, and attached ENIs prior to isolation.

actions.name: CreateForensicEBSSnapshots
actions.description: Iterates through all attached EBS volumes (Root + Data) and initiates AWS EBS snapshots tagged with Incident ID and ForensicChainOfCustody metadata.

actions.name: IsolateNetworkPerimeter
actions.description: Detaches existing Security Groups and binds the instance exclusively to the SOAR-Isolation-SG (0 Inbound, 0 Outbound rules).

actions.name: ApplyQuarantineTags
actions.description: Applies resource tags: SOAR_Status=Quarantined, SOAR_IsolatedAt=<timestamp>, SOAR_IncidentId=<id>.

actions.name: DispatchSecOpsAlert
actions.description: Dispatches high-priority alert with forensic snapshot IDs and isolation confirmation to SecOps responders.

recovery_procedure: Mount the forensic EBS snapshots to an isolated sandbox analysis EC2 instance for reverse malware analysis.
Inspect instance memory dump and disk logs for rootkits or persistence mechanisms.
Terminate or rebuild the compromised host from golden AMI baseline.
